remarks: This upper-level residence offers an impressive one-bedroom, one-bath layout with an open-concept design, hardwood flooring,  10-foot ceilings, oversized windows, and ceiling fans throughout. The stylish kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops, elegant cream cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a dishwasher, microwave, charming, screened-sunroom provides a peaceful space to relax and enjoy the coastal breeze year-round. The spacious bedroom offers excellent closet space and comfort. Additional amenities include a whole-house generator, security alarm system, and dedicated parking for each residence, providing convenience and peace of mind. Outside, the expansive landscaped backyard serves as a private sanctuary with ample room for entertaining, gardening, recreation, or simply enjoying the beautiful surroundings. The location is truly unmatched. Nestled in one of the region's most sought-after neighborhoods, you'll enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle just steps from the waterfront and the acclaimed Prime restaurant
